After the second recovery, nine bots returned toward the canonical corridor anchor (-328.403,-88.0364,213.921), but the raid leader's generic repeated-death safe-memory policy selected (-339.765,-316.824,212.549), behind the entrance and outside the live pack. The final leader decision was incorrect: a per-bot generic safe-memory override displaced the immutable current-generation live-pack and route-anchor authority. The minimum-distance evidence is mixed but not the terminal cause: the trace contains 43 successful union-safe minimum-distance exits and 46 failed exits across seven ranged/healer bots. No source, DBC, or live evidence authorizes weakening the exact 15-yard spell-79604 avoidance contract. Magmaw entry 41570 was never reached, so no boss-tactic, gameplay, or 4.4.2 fidelity inference is authorized.
